description: Search the tool catalogue by what you are trying to do — "delete", "milestone", "review", "custom field" — and get back the matching tools with their descriptions. Every tool is already listed and callable; use this when you do not know which one fits, rather than re-reading the whole list. Cost: no API call, matching happens in memory, about 3ms.

query.description: Search query to find tools by name or description. Examples: "delete", "milestone", "attachment", "suite"
